description: This PHP file defines the 'Authorize' controller class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class manages various account authorization functions such as displaying the authorization page, sending authorization codes, saving authorization data, resetting (unlocking) authorization, confirming authorization links, and unlocking accounts. The code implements logic for token management, user authentication checks, redirect handling, session management, and interaction with models for customer authorization data.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class for managing account authorization workflows including login, token verification, authorization reset, and account unlocking within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the authorization page, setting up the necessary scripts, data, and handling token creation if needed.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles sending authorization codes via email, verifying token status, and redirecting as needed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to confirm authorization using codes, manages attempts, and redirects upon success or failure.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Displays the account authorization reset (unlock) view if the user has exceeded attempt limits.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Creates a token that can be used to verify account ownership for authorization purposes.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Handles account unlocking by verifying email and code, resetting authorization status, and logging out the customer.
